name: Shimotsuki Mirei
source:
[url=/c105018]Kaoru[/url]'s former homeroom teacher from middle school. She taught art.
She appears to be a cool, mature woman at first glance, but in reality, she has a carefree personality that is quite unlike a typical teacher, as she loves alcohol and cigarettes (e-cigarettes these days).
Following a runaway incident that occurred when Kaoru was in her third year of junior high school, she resigned from her job at a private junior and senior high school. After a period of unemployment, she now works as an instructor at an art school run by an acquaintance.
They reconnected after Kaoru entered high school, and although Kaoru still calls her "Sensei," their relationship remains somewhere between friends and lovers.

[From [url=https://lycoris-works.com/usonatsu#character]official website[/url]]
